I am so sorry you are going through this. Discovering infidelity is incredibly painful, and it makes complete sense that you are feeling unsettled and struggling with intrusive thoughts, even though you want to forgive her. Your shared history of nine years, your son, and your own past experience of being forgiven add a lot of complexity to this situation. It is completely normal to want to save the relationship while still hurting deeply. 

Rebuilding trust takes time, patience, and effort from both partners. Seeking the guidance of a licensed couples counselor could be incredibly beneficial for your family right now. A therapist can provide a safe, neutral space to navigate these painful emotions, address the root causes of the infidelity, and help you both communicate openly. You might also find individual therapy helpful to process the difficult images and feelings you are experiencing. Take things one day at a time and be gentle with yourself as you navigate this healing process.
